RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel does not prove discrimination, though affinity bias may have played a subconscious role. For a head of department role, banks often prioritize regulatory affairs and executive stakeholder management over pure quantitative or statistical depth, which gives the selected candidate a plausible, legitimate justification.

Do not confront them about the panel's gender composition yet. Doing so without documentation risks damaging your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your interview evaluation and constructive feedback. If the bank stonewalls or provides contradictory rationales, consult an employment attorney to evaluate whether formal action is warranted.
